intent.caption: Feature triptych — Three feature cards in rhythm with icon seats, title/body hierarchy, and hover lift states.

textContent.text: Every movement is designed, machined, and finished under one roof.
Each piece is serviced free of charge for five years from delivery.
Guilloche cut on a 1912 rose engine, one dial at a time.

visualSpec.effects: Three cards 1.5w x 1.9h scene units in a row, gap 0.25 (1x base unit), row total 5.0w centered at origin; card albedo vertical ramp #191921 (at 0.0) -> #121218 (at 1.0), corner radius 0.06, 0.006-unit hairline border #26262f, roughness 0.6, metalness 0.25, clearcoat 0.15; icon seat per card is a machined disc 0.4 diameter, extruded 0.05, brushed anisotropy 0.6, roughness 0.55, metalness 0.5, clearcoat 0.2, carrying a single mono glyph in #ff2a38 emissive intensity 1.6; interior padding 0.375 (1.5x base), vertical rhythm icon seat then 0.25 gap then title then 0.125 gap then body, all on a 0.25-unit baseline grid; mount stagger-cards with each card fade-up opacity 0 -> 1 and y +0.2 -> 0 over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) at 80ms stagger; hover lift y 0 -> 0.06 and translateZ 0 -> 0.12 over 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) with the contact shadow under the card widening and softening as it rises, disc glyph emissive 1.6 -> 2.2 on the hovered card; the key light sits upper-left so lifted cards gain a brighter top bevel and a deeper bottom edge, making the lift read as physical.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Cards cascade in at 80ms stagger; the hovered card lifts 0.06 up and 0.12 toward camera with a widening contact shadow and brighter disc glyph.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 body on card ramp; 3:1 titles; accent glyphs 4.6:1 on disc
